tools.name: health
tools.description: Service health, storage mode, trackingTag status, and catalog count.

tools.name: list_marketplaces
tools.description: List supported Amazon storefronts (id, domain, defaultLocale). Match marketplace + locale to the end user: amazon.com (tag sw-dormkit-20) for the US, amazon.se (tag sw-dormkit-21) for Sweden.

tools.name: search_kit_items
tools.description: Search dorm / back-to-school essentials. Returns Amazon search deep-links (and optional catalog matches). Pass marketplace=amazon.com + locale=en-US for US shoppers (amazon.com links, English queries) or marketplace=amazon.se for Sweden. Missing store falls back (en-US → amazon.com, else amazon.se).

tools.name: list_catalog_items
tools.description: Browse the hand-picked dorm essentials catalog for a storefront. marketplace=amazon.com (US) returns verified amazon.com /dp/ product links; marketplace=amazon.se returns the Swedish catalog with amazon.se /dp/ links. Optional q/category filters.

tools.name: create_kit
tools.description: Create an empty or pre-filled dorm kit wishlist. Returns id, editToken, ownerUrl, roommateUrl. marketplace=amazon.com + locale=en-US for US shoppers; amazon.se for Sweden. Missing store falls back (en-US → amazon.com, else amazon.se).

tools.name: create_and_fill_kit
tools.description: One-shot: create a dorm kit and fill from itemQueries, itemKeywords, and/or itemAsins. marketplace=amazon.com + locale=en-US for US shoppers; amazon.se for Sweden. Missing store falls back (en-US → amazon.com, else amazon.se).

tools.name: add_kit_item
tools.description: Add an item to an existing dorm kit. Requires kit id and editToken from create_kit / create_and_fill_kit.

tools.name: resolve_product
tools.description: Resolve ASIN, Amazon URL, or keywords to a buy deep-link on the selected marketplace. amazon.se links carry ?tag=sw-dormkit-21; amazon.com links carry ?tag=sw-dormkit-20. Missing store falls back (en-US → amazon.com, else amazon.se).

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_marketplaces" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List supported Amazon storefronts (id, domain, defaultLocale). Prefer matching marketplace + locale to the end user. Until real Associates IDs are registered, links omit ?tag= (tagConfigured=false). Never invent placeholders." → after: "List supported Amazon storefronts (id, domain, defaultLocale). Match marketplace + locale to the end user: amazon.com (tag sw-dormkit-20) for the US, amazon.se (tag sw-dormkit-21) for Sweden."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
